answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks through dynamic proof-of-burn registration. An agent must irreversibly destroy scarce native tokens to join, logging proof in an onyx deposit registry. Nodes monitor the fee delta across epochs to scale burn minimums, ensuring any ripple of synthetic identities incurs steep financial costs per clone. However, non-refundable burning introduces economic deadweight loss and excludes capital-constrained honest agents.
